notes.title: Patch 1.0.0 Major Update
notes.content:
[h2]Mode Added[/h2]
- Normal Mode: Endure and Escape
   On the morning of Day 5, an escape route will be secured at a specific location. Hold on and escape.

- Endless Mode: Survive to the End
   There is no escape route. Survive as long as you can.

[h2]Difficulty Added[/h2]
- Master Difficulty significantly increases difficulty in various aspects.
   Master the Normal Difficulty before challenging the Master Difficulty.

[h2]Legendary Box Added[/h2]
- Contains items that greatly affect survival.
   Be sure to acquire it.

[h2]Others[/h2]
1. Rebalanced character stats
2. Added weather effects (Rain)
3. Various QoL features added
4. Bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931982/6aa17d9a64e14e4b00f2016a51190d778c3229df.gif[/img]

[h2]Haru: Character Balance Patch[/h2]
Rebalanced to fit Haru's role.

1. Defense distribution readjusted
2. Evasion rate distribution readjusted
3. Added a new feature: 25 HP regeneration every 5 seconds
4. Added a new feature: 35% bonus from health recovery items
5. Starting equipment and items provided
6. Skill 2 (Run) > Added a stun effect upon landing


[h2]Woody: Character Balance Patch[/h2]
Rebalanced to fit Woody's role.

1. Defense distribution readjusted
2. Evasion rate distribution readjusted
3. Block distribution readjusted
4. Added a new feature: 25 HP regeneration every 5 seconds
5. Added a new feature: 35% bonus from health recovery items
6. Stun effect distribution readjusted
7. Starting items provided
8. Overbalance effect removed


[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
1. The HP icon in the side info tab now displays HP values in green.
2. Pressing the ~ key will move the screen to the base.
3. Fixed an issue where the active inventory would turn off.
4. Other bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931982/073720e9025ca0400463564e1e9b1a85be40e82e.gif[/img]

[h2]Harry: Character Balance Patch[/h2]

Harry has been restructured to fit the original design intent, enabling him to perform as a tank.

1. Increase in base defense
2. Increased efficiency of Skill 1 (Shield Mode)
3. Addition of health recovery (50) every 5 seconds
4. Added health recovery item bonus (100%)
5. Early gear and items provided, fitting his role as a police officer
6. Removal of unnecessary Harry equipment items

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
1. Improve visibility of total zombie bullet train

2. Improve visibility of dropped items

3. Add character screen lock mode
    When the character screen lock mode is activated, the screen is fixed to the character.
   
   - Activation method
   3.1 Keyboard key : F1 > On/Off
   3.2 Options window : Character screen lock mode > Checkbox On/Off

4. Improve screen size and character control
(When screen lock mode is deactivated: Holding the spacebar will make the screen follow the character)

5. Miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931982/2df4c86221eae5547e37843abd83a1fb9c039d78.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931982/2df4c86221eae5547e37843abd83a1fb9c039d78.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Significant Improvements in Screen Control [/h2]
- We have significantly improved inconvenient screen controls such as screen movement, delay after moving the screen, and screen rotation. 

- We have modified the screen size, screen movement, and delay after moving the screen to the most popular method.

- We have removed the inconvenient screen rotation feature. Now, if a character is buried behind an object, the object will become transparent, eliminating the need for screen rotation.

[h2]Character Control Improvement[/h2]
- We have solved the issue with the rapid fire rate of close-range characters, enabling better control.

[h2]ETC[/h2]
- ncreased visibility elements in the game (items, landmarks)
